atacama.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay)
atacama.description: Hyper-arid desert with perchlorate-bearing soils, high UV radiation, dry salt flats, and negligible organics, widely used as Mars dry-lake and soil analog.

haughton.name: Haughton Impact Crater
haughton.description: 23-km meteorite impact crater in barren polar desert terrain, featuring shattered breccia, hydrothermal paleolakes, permafrost, and NASA Haughton-Mars Project base.

kilbourne.name: Kilbourne Hole Maar
kilbourne.description: Volcanic maar crater with xenolith mantle xenocrysts and ejecta rim, used for lunar surface science training by Apollo astronauts and Artemis field crews.

death_valley.name: Death Valley (Badwater Basin)
death_valley.description: Enclosed fault-block graben basin with large alluvial fans, salt playa flats, and severe aridity, mimicking Martian basin sedimentation.

iceland.name: Iceland Highlands (Askja / Holuhraun)
iceland.description: Barren basaltic volcanic plains, tephra sand, and volcanic craters used by Apollo astronauts and Artemis teams for lunar and Martian terrain/rover testing.

mojave.name: Mojave Desert (Cima / Kelso)
mojave.description: Basin and range desert with basaltic volcanic fields, sand dunes, and arid bajadas, used extensively by NASA JPL for Mars rover trials.

mcmurdo.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys
mcmurdo.description: Hyper-arid, ultra-cold ice-free polar desert valleys with permafrost, sandstone ventifacts, and endolithic microbes, serving as prime Mars and lunar polar analogs.
